facts.fact: Morocco's data protection authority, the CNDP, chaired by Omar Seghrouchni, had a resolution on privacy-enhancing technologies adopted at the Global Privacy Assembly in Brussels on 17 November 2026, showing the body in operation.

systems.country_label: Commission nationale de controle de la protection des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: Morocco's CNDP, headed by Omar Seghrouchni, was acting as the country's data protection authority at the Global Privacy Assembly in Brussels on 17 November 2026, where it had a resolution adopted.

MAR.note: Document states nothing on local government offices.
A network priority to harmonise national laws is named, with no text signed, ratified or transposed by Morocco.

facts.fact: Morocco's CNDP took part in the work of the African Network of Data Protection Authorities (NADPA-RAPDP), of which Morocco holds the permanent secretariat, at a meeting reported on 18 November 2026.

The first meeting of the new executive bureau of the African Network of Data Protection Authorities (NADPA-RAPDP) was held in Rabat in September 2026, with Morocco holding the network's permanent secretariat.
